thread:
anya: Heads up — after yesterday's v2-ptq rollout to staging, reranker MRR@10 dropped ~3.4% on the synthetic holdout. NDCG@5 down ~1.2%. Looks correlated with the embedding-scale change (we set embed_scale=0.85).

mike: ugh. is that across all slices or a specific cohort?

anya: tail-heavy queries (short queries, high click sparsity) mostly. Core queries barely moved.

sanjay: confirm this is int8 PTQ only? or also seen on fp16/dedicated?

anya: only on the int8 PTQ rollout so far. fp16 baseline unchanged.

leo: quick hypothesis: we applied global embed scaling after quantization to compress dynamic range. maybe it interacts with L2 normalization/priming magnitude. Could push topk ordering slightly.

diana: do we still normalize embeddings before cosine? last PR replaced per-batch L2 norm with a fused op in runtime. that might have subtle numeric diff with quantized weights.

mike: can we run two quick A/B queues: (A) embed_scale=1.0 with current PTQ, (B) embed_scale=0.85 (current). also run both with explicit L2 normalize after quantization to see delta.

anya: agree. small experiment plan:
- take 5k holdout queries (same as CI holdout)
- run weekly-eval harness with seeds fixed
- variants: PTQ+scale=1.0 (no norm), PTQ+scale=0.85 (no norm), PTQ+scale=1.0+post-normalize, PTQ+scale=0.85+post-normalize, fp16 baseline
- measure NDCG@1/5 and MRR@10 + top1 mismatch rate

sanjay: I'll kick off the jobs. command I'm using:
```
python -m eval.rerank --model checkpoint:ptq/v2 --holdout holdout/5k.json \
  --batch 256 --embed-scale {SCALE} --post-norm {true|false} --seed 42
```

ci-bot: started job 54721 for 4 variants (owners: sanjay)

leo: also dump a sample of 100 mismatches (top1 different from baseline) with scores + raw text for manual inspection. look for priming token alignment / whitespace effects.

anya: good call. add `--dump-mismatches 100 --mismatch-output /tmp/mismatches.json`

sanjay: runs started; expect ~40m per variant on staging nodes. posting results when done.

(45 minutes later)

ci-bot: job 54721 finished: artifacts at s3://redwood-eval/54721/

mike: results?

anya: preliminary:
- fp16 baseline: MRR@10 0.412, NDCG@5 0.372
- PTQ scale=0.85 (current): MRR@10 0.398, NDCG@5 0.367
- PTQ scale=1.0 (no post-norm): MRR@10 0.405, NDCG@5 0.369
- PTQ scale=1.0 + post-normalize: MRR@10 0.411, NDCG@5 0.371
- PTQ scale=0.85 + post-normalize: MRR@10 0.404, NDCG@5 0.368

leo: looks like post-normalize recovers most of the delta when scale=1.0. scale=0.85 still underperforms a bit even with post-normalize.

diana: that suggests the scaling compresses relative distances before normalizing, losing rank fidelity for some short queries. the fused op numeric diff also matters but smaller.

mike: two takeaways: revert to embed_scale=1.0 for the PTQ rollout (safe), and add an explicit post-quantize L2 normalization in the runtime fused path to match fp16 semantics.

anya: I'll open a rollback PR for the rollout config and a follow-up runtime PR to add optional post-normalize with a feature flag.

anya: PRs:
- rollback config: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/PR-921 (revert scale to 1.0)
- runtime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/PR-2031 (add post-quantize normalize + flag `quant_post_normalize`)

mike: please add the small unit test comparing cosine distances between fp16 and ptq+postnorm for 100 random vectors to avoid regressions.

diana: will do. also adding an eval alert to block auto-rollout if MRR@10 drops >1.5% vs baseline on the staging holdout.

sanjay: done. rolling rollback out to staging now. tracking in release notes.

anya: thanks all. leaving mismatch dump in S3 for anyone who wants to eyeball examples: s3://redwood-eval/54721/mismatches.json

leo: nice triage. follow-up: let's add a short doc to ops about "embed scaling + quantization gotchas" with recommended defaults.

mike: agreed. assign to diana to draft.

diana: putting on my list, will share draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
